title: Jannatal Tiddigille Naharsi Aamanti
intro: ucsub soolo caxaaxuwih addat qigduk tan salaam, kunnabna inkih tan ginok dagah, dubuk inki cuduuduk massakaxxa luk. Tutucto amotani xagana taceeh, inki doorit kullim milaagah, uxih racmatta wadirih gita fakta. iyyaay sahdayti baxi qemmok qemmissa haanam yabtam?
clues: Anu Yalli kallaytak gineeh, yallih hanaawih bicse.
Yalli malaykoota sujuud yoh abtam amrisse waqdi anu konnabna luk suge.
Anu inni barra lih jannatal waara, inki caxak iroh inkih ruffa axce.
anu duquuruseh suge sheytan tutuctot xiibite baguuk fayseena akkele.
Anu waaseenih yanin caxak okmeeh, yi reebu qaybik yok duugumteh.
Toobokoyti qangor yi Rabbik barteeh, Yalli yoh yuduureh racmattah.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: meysik iroh saytun baaxo culaanam cineenih
Sheytan tutuctok lakal kalalisen caxak yokmen.
trial.answer: Sheytan tutuctok lakal kalalisen caxak yokmen.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Anu kaxxa weeqih addat yooqeh suge kaafiritte lih.
Yalli toobi qangor yoo bariseeh yoh cabteh .
Yalla ablem esserak cankaxi yoo yoogoreh suge.
Anu naqabut cabeemih taagah kaxxa kullumti yoh yanxuqeh suge
Anu sabti ayro yiggileemih taagah inni ummatta lih milaagimeh suge
outcome.answer: Yalli toobi qangor yoo bariseeh yoh cabteh .

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
